name: Supabase MCP Server
upstream_status_note: The repository moved from supabase-community/supabase-mcp to supabase/mcp; the old address redirects. The npm package name is unchanged.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10; partly meets C5.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @supabase/mcp-server-supabase@0.17.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/supabase/mcp.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.17.0 is dated 2026-11-13; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-14.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The publisher's documentation describes project scoping, a read-only mode and feature-group selection as options to set. Quoted: “Use project scoping, read-only mode, restricted feature groups, and the narrowest data query that can answer the question.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The hosted server is reached through a Supabase sign-in prompted by the MCP client; no token is placed in the documented configuration. Quoted: “Your MCP client will automatically prompt you to log in to Supabase during setup.”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README points to the publisher's security guidance, which names prompt injection and gives recommendations. Quoted: “we recommend you read our [security best practices](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp#security-risks)”; “The primary attack vector unique to LLMs is prompt injection”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/node ^2.0.0. Lower-bound version 2.0.0 of @modelcontextprotocol/node (npm) was published on 2026-07-27, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
